title: Hazbin Hotel This Radio
blurb: Radio is the entire conceit of Alastor, not a decorative touch. He broadcasts, he crackles, and his voice arrives with the faint compression of a valve set, a texture Hazbin Hotel leans on constantly to make a cartoon demon feel transmitted from a much older era. This clip gives you a few seconds of exactly that, complete with the tinny warmth the sound design goes out of its way to preserve. Fans use it as a scene-setter in edits. Everyone else gets an unusually theatrical announcement.
origin: An Alastor radio line from Hazbin Hotel.
